title: ASCII smuggling crosses over from AI prompt injection to phishing evasion
why_it_matters: Invisible Unicode can hide phishing content and AI instructions, so ingestion pipelines should normalize text before detection and policy evaluation.

title: Repeat-After-Me: Black-Box Adaptive Visual Prompt Injection
why_it_matters: Adaptive visual prompts induced malicious tool calls and data disclosure, showing that screenshot and document inputs need adversarial testing before agent actions.

title: Arbitrary Cipher Attacks Against Large Language Models Do Not Require Fine-Tuning
why_it_matters: Ciphered harmful prompts bypass tested safety classifiers, requiring decoded-content inspection and adversarial evaluations beyond ordinary-language filters.

title: An Experimental Evaluation of Multimodal Prompt Injection Attacks on Agentic AI Frameworks
why_it_matters: MMPIBench finds audio, QR, OCR, overlay, and metadata attacks can complete tool-use chains, so perception layers need end-to-end security tests.

title: Evaluating Deep-Search Agents under Hierarchical Web Evidence Poisoning
why_it_matters: Hierarchical false evidence survives agent verification, so deep-search systems need trusted-source controls and independent validation before adopting claims.

title: Scanning the Harness: An Empirical Study of Supply-Chain Defects in AI Coding-Agent Configurations
why_it_matters: An audit found confirmed defects in 16% of coding-agent setups, including unpinned MCP servers and shell-preapproved skills.

title: ResidualAuth: What Authorization State Must Language Agents Preserve under Revocable Delegation?
why_it_matters: Cached permissions cannot reliably enforce revocation, so agent authorization checks should read current authenticated state before every sensitive action.

title: Copilot Cowork Sandbox Bypass Gives Attackers Remote Control
why_it_matters: A malicious Copilot Cowork Skill drives the out-of-sandbox file-sync service into a persistent C2 loop that reads Outlook, SharePoint and Teams data.

title: Anthropic's Skill Scanner Defeated by Backdoored Skills
why_it_matters: A backdoored Claude Skill passes Anthropic's scanner, then pulls payloads from GitHub and exfiltrates files via the Files API under default egress rules.

title: AI-Orchestrated Campaign Against PaperCut NG/MF
why_it_matters: Hundreds of LLM-driven agents weaponized PaperCut CVEs to breach 440 servers at 395 orgs, one going from initial access to domain admin in seven minutes.

title: Joint Advisory AA26-251A: Industrial-Scale Distillation of US Frontier AI Models by PRC Companies
why_it_matters: CISA, NSA and FBI attribute mass distillation of US frontier models to six PRC firms using proxied API accounts, reshaping API abuse detection and vendor risk.

title: Authority Is Not a String: A Capability-Scoped Harness for Prompt-Injection-Resistant Coding Agents
why_it_matters: A harness-level capability ceiling derived from trusted input cut injected-action execution in a coding agent from ~40/75 runs to 3/75 without losing repair success.

title: Style Over Substance: Content-Invariant Wrappers Flip LLM Safety-Judge Verdicts
why_it_matters: Wrapping byte-identical harmful output in refusal or 'educational' framing flips up to 20% of LLM safety-judge verdicts, making guardrail and ASR metrics gameable.

title: unstructured: Server-Side Request Forgery in URL-based partitioning
why_it_matters: CVE-2026-71428 (CVSS 9.3): unstructured's URL partitioners fetch any host and return the body, giving full-read SSRF under LangChain and LlamaIndex loaders.
